IT’S A NEW DAY.
CLICK THE BUTTON BELOW TO START YOUR MORNING ROUTINE

NOTES:

For this warm up you may follow along, or go at your own pace and perform as many repetitions in each movement based on your body’s needs today.
Bodyweight Warm Up
Marching in Place*
Rise and Falls
Knee Circles
Hip Flexion-Extension
Leg Swings
Pelvic Rocks
Pelvic Circles
Spinal Roll Downs
Side Wipes
Translations
Side Bend with Reaching
Pummel Series*
Neck Figure 8’s*
Wrist Shakes
Body Drops
Suggested repetitions are between 8-30 on each movement
Marching in Place
Marching in Place can be substituted with any form of light cardio movement you’d like – a brisk walk outdoors, a rower, bike, etc.
Pummel Series:
If you experience challenges with the elbow circles, allow your thumb to separate from your body as needed to create smooth movements.
Neck Figure 8’s:
At any time if you feel dizzy when looking up, stop and/or skip this exercises. You can explore keeping your eyes focused forward and see if that’s makes a difference.
